bio: A chameleon hatchling with a long, sleek dark crest. Its scales shade themselves darker at the edges, so it always looks its best from the front.
A glowing ring of scales on its head lights its face from every angle. It changes colour to whatever is trending before anyone else notices the trend.
It turns its own colours into a range and sells them back to the other chameleons. It is always posing; nobody has seen it from the side.
note: Holds still for a photo, never for anything else.
Its pout is a separate muscle.
Has a shade of itself for every day of the year.
